issues.description: The problem statement contains conflicting specifications for the return type of messageOnMilk(): the Milkable interface in the UML is declared to return boolean, and the textual description says it should return true/false, whereas the class diagrams for Seal and Goat declare messageOnMilk() as returning String. The provided solution implements Milkable.messageOnMilk() as returning String. This inconsistency (boolean vs String) will confuse students about the expected signature and prevent them from implementing classes that correctly satisfy the interface chosen.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type of messageOnMilk() consistent across the specification, template examples, and solution. Preferably align the problem statement with the solution/class diagrams by specifying Milkable.messageOnMilk(): String and update the textual description to state that messageOnMilk() should return a String message (e.g., "Seal <name> is milked"). Alternatively, if the intent was boolean, update the class diagrams and the solution so Milkable.messageOnMilk() returns boolean and adjust all implementations and example usages accordingly.
